filterSummary: Selected 5 English videos covering all topics. No suitable Arabic videos were found as candidates were either irrelevant, on related but incorrect topics (e.g., calculus surface area instead of SAH), or in the wrong language.

coverage.note: Candidates are about the .bvh animation file format, not the spatial data structure, failing relevance gate.
All candidates are about calculating surface area in calculus, not the Surface Area Heuristic for BVH construction, failing relevance gate.
Candidates discuss general trees or Decision Trees, not k-d trees for spatial partitioning, failing relevance gate.

videos.title: Coding Adventure: More Ray Tracing!
videos.filter_reason: An outstanding practical coding tutorial from a highly respected creator that clearly explains and implements a BVH, validated by its massive view count.

videos.title: Rendering Lecture 1 - Spatial Acceleration Structures
videos.filter_reason: This university lecture provides a thorough explanation of various acceleration structures, including a clear segment on BVH construction using the SAH.

videos.title: K-d Trees - Computerphile
videos.filter_reason: A clear, concise, and well-animated explanation from a highly reputable educational channel, making it the best choice for understanding the core concept.

videos.title: Online Computer Graphics II: Rendering: Raytracing Acceleration: Acceleration Structures and Grids
videos.filter_reason: This is a direct and focused university lecture on ray tracing acceleration, with a specific section dedicated to explaining uniform grids.
